title: Changes of Oropharyngeal Flora
brief_summary: Hospitalised patients have in contrast to healthy people enteric pathogenic bacteria in their oropharynx Increased risk of pneumonia due to the pathogens in the oropharynx Probiotics can reduce such bacteria in intubated critically ill patients This study will use two strain of probiotic bacteria for half of the patients and a placebo for the rest Active arm gurgles with a suspension twice a day Cultures at inclusion and at set time intervals The results of cultures from the two groups will be compared as will the use of antibiotics
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Admitted to hospital
* Anticipated length of hospital stay 3 days or more

Exclusion Criteria:

* Immune insufficiency
* Prior participation in the study
* Not being able to understand study information
